name: Rephrase AI
tagline: Rephrase what you wrote into what you meant to say.
description: Rephrase AI helps you rewrite what you already wrote so it says what you meant. Paste a sentence, paragraph, email, or full draft, choose a writing profile, and get a new version that keeps your meaning. The four profiles are Academic, Professional, Casual, and Creative, and you can adjust formality, complexity, brevity, and creativity from there. SuperRephrase Mode adds a deeper refinement pass. Compare each rephrase with your original before you use it. The Free plan includes 3 rephrases a month, and Pro is $29 a month after a 7-day trial.
